triggers.description: Bare Actuating compiles, realizes, publishes, reviews, and closes.
Explicit routes select implement, triage, remediation-plan, or review-closeout.
A current or projected witnessed falsifier may require counterexample-to-construction compilation.
exclusions: mechanical mistake with no correctness-bearing semantic pressure

triggers.description: A current witness may revoke an exact eliminated construction claim.
Review scheduling and evidence acquisition falsify a completed candidate.

routes.description: Acquire and classify evidence without mutation.
Falsify, compile successor, realize, publish, and converge.

required_artifacts: owner-issued validation, review, publication, and counterexample evidence when applicable
success_signals: Git remains the realized construction
CAS owns review receipts and observations
Review Fold owns semantic admission to the counterexample corpus
Ship owns public effects
Actuating keeps no durable workflow or counterexample store
failure_signals: stored Actuating verdict outranks owner facts
review or publication evidence is copied into an Actuating database
Actuating duplicates the Review Fold counterexample corpus
clauses.rationale: Actuating derives decisions from current owner facts and projected semantic evidence.

success_signals: only entailed current findings create automatic counterexample pressure
stored counterexamples are reclassified against the current Goal and head
new requirements reopen authority
failure_signals: review silently expands the Goal
preference is implemented as correctness work
a CEX record is treated as permanently current
clauses.rationale: Correct by construction is relative to accepted laws and current applicability.

required_artifacts: projected counterexample basis and evidence-horizon disposition
success_signals: candidate selection follows the canonical constructional-dominance order before lifecycle and realization cost or raw source size
review findings and historical CEX witnesses compile into one current legal state space
every sanctioned producer factors through the canonical boundary
downstream primary compensators retire or become derived
failure_signals: finding maps directly to a patch
historical counterexamples are ignored without an explicit incomplete horizon
carrier or producer topology is omitted
same-family recurrence adds another member guard
factor count or raw line count selects architecture
clauses.rationale: Actuating exists to turn a sufficient current and historical counterexample basis into a construction that excludes its family.

required_artifacts: boundary dispositions: preserved | made irrelevant by mechanism change | requires new authority
success_signals: Goal-owned laws, required observations, explicit compatibility, non-goals, and authorized effects govern candidate admissibility
host capabilities and authority-backed resource ceilings receive an honest feasibility account
incumbent-relative burdens remain evidence and may be eliminated by a mechanism change
a candidate that makes an incumbent-generated boundary irrelevant remains eligible when required observations are preserved
a candidate requiring new authority is surfaced without silent adoption
failure_signals: Metanoetic is constrained to the incumbent implementation envelope
a candidate ignores a hard boundary
an incumbent-generated burden is treated as immutable without authority
new authority is silently assumed
a candidate lacks an operational resource account, smallest witness, or falsifier
clauses.rationale: Actuating constrains challenger admissibility, not Metanoetic's imagination.

required_artifacts: one architectural axis and typed hole per Universalist invocation
linked split invocations for independently governed axes
source-anchored producer, consumer, composition-edge, transition, residual, invalidator, and bypass obligations
success_signals: Universalist nomination is treated as proof-carrying compiler input rather than architectural advice
every nominated boundary element becomes an Actuating realization obligation before mutation
independent seams are split, proved separately, and recomposed explicitly
the witness can fail when a sanctioned producer, consumer, edge, transition, residual, invalidator, or bypass is omitted
Actuating preserves the nomination's explicit claim strength
failure_signals: a prose-only Universalist nomination is selected
one compound nomination hides independently governed axes
passing tests substitute for complete boundary-contract realization
Actuating silently strengthens a bounded or contained nomination into elimination
an omitted producer, consumer, composition edge, transition, residual, invalidator, or bypass cannot falsify the proof
Universalist is given mutation, selection, or reviewable authority
clauses.rationale: Universalist nominates one boundary; Actuating compiles and proves its complete contract before selection, mutation, or reviewability.

success_signals: isolated restoration changes no carrier, cut, producer topology, or bypass set
failure_signals: new semantic constructor hides inside restoration
direct gate substitutes for family, historical, or producer proof
clauses.rationale: Direct repair is only honest restoration of an already-correct construction.

required_artifacts: review-fold/counterexample-corpus basis projection or explicit incomplete horizon
current Review Fold with projected and captured CEX identities
success_signals: material finding invalidates candidate and closes mutation
parallel waits for launched outcomes
serial completes remaining initial lenses for evidence only
stored counterexamples are reclassified rather than trusted as current
new current entailed accepted witnesses are captured once by semantic identity
review resumes only on a completely proved successor
failure_signals: serial mode edits after first finding
review stops before sufficient evidence basis
review authors successor one finding at a time
absence from an incomplete corpus is called first-observed or eliminated
current class, family, owner, cut, carrier, route, or closure is persisted in the corpus
clauses.rationale: Independent review plus durable admitted witnesses supplies the counterexample basis before construction selection.

required_artifacts: counterexample horizon sufficient for every historical claim
success_signals: invalid family is unrepresentable or unadmittable
all producers factor through the carrier
bypasses close
historical absence is used only under a complete evidence horizon
five standard cleans survive on one head
failure_signals: repaired examples substitute for family proof
safe but wound-shaped realization closes
same-family finding is answered by another guard
missing historical evidence is treated as proof
clauses.rationale: Closure is a current proof that the realized construction excludes the family under the evidence actually available.

instrumentation.rationale: Actuating reports a live judgment; Review Fold alone persists admitted witness evidence.
